steps.title: Confirm federal Express Entry eligibility
steps.description: Qualify for CEC, FSWP or FSTP, create an Express Entry profile and enter the pool before seeking a PEI nomination.

preparationChecklist.text: Read the current official instructions for this stage.
Keep copies of submissions, confirmations and messages.

commonMistakes: Using outdated requirements or forms.
Missing a deadline or failing to report a material change.

steps.title: Check PEI priorities and special work rules
steps.description: PEI prioritizes candidates working and living in the province. Certain PGWP holders who graduated outside PEI and certain spousal open-work-permit holders need nine continuous months with the supporting employer and at least four months remaining on the permit when submitting the EOI.

requiredDocuments.title: PEI employment and permit evidence
